sentences: How have things been since I saw you last?
I had to get a different bus to work yesterday because my usual one was cancelled.
I ended up at a stop I'd never used before.
Have you had anything happen this week that you want to tell me about?
Outside the library, the stop by the big crossing.
Well, there was this woman with a green bag but I don't know her.
So you were waiting on your own, with another passenger there.
The app said delayed and then it changed to cancelled.
What did you do when you saw that?
I walked to the other stop.
It's the 24, not the 24A, because the 24A goes the long way round.
You checked which service you needed and walked to the other stop.
How did you feel about all that?
My face got hot and I kept checking the time.
I was going to be late.
Was it mainly the worry about being late, do you think?
I was going to be late.
Yes, you were watching the time because you needed to get there.
What happened after you got to the other stop?
The driver let me use my bus pass.
Did anything else happen on the journey?
How did the whole thing finish?
You were waiting outside the library, the bus was cancelled on the app, and you walked to the stop for the 24.
You were checking the time because you were going to be late, and then you got on the bus and got there.
Is there anything important I've missed?
That's a clear account of what happened.
Can we do the card game now?

written.summary: The child told about a bus delay and solution. The child mentioned their usual bus was cancelled and they had to take a different one. The child described getting on the 24 instead of the 24A.
goals: Use the exact word instead of vague words like 'stuff' or 'thing'.
focus: The child will name how they felt during an activity.
